caption: The drawing consists of a square bordered with a thin brown line, set against a plain, light-colored background. Inside the square, there is a symmetrical arrangement of colored shapes. At the center is a large, six-pointed star-like shape colored in red, with a regular grid of small yellow dots evenly distributed across its surface. In each corner of the square, there are three-pronged forms resembling stylized plant or coral shapes; the shapes in the upper left and lower right are red with yellow dots, while those in the upper right and lower left are yellow with small black dots. The letters "E.T.H" are written in red capital letters below the central star-like shape, near the bottom center of the square.
title: Pieced Autograph Quilt (1 Piece)
